title: How Much of the Agency Service Lines Is Taken Off a Voucher Raised on an Air Ticket Fare Brands Booking
content:
Where the agency service lines standing on a cancelled Air Ticket Fare Brands booking already stand for every traveller ticketed, part or all of them may be left on the voucher instead of taken off it. Two readings decide it together: how the service lines compare with the travellers ticketed, and how long the credit of the fare brand that produced the voucher runs.

## 1. What is taken off

| Where | Of the agency service lines, what is taken off is |
| --- | --- |
| the booking's service lines stand for as many travellers as are ticketed and the brand's credit runs 18 months or more | 0 of them, so that none of the service lines is taken off |
| the booking's service lines stand for as many travellers as are ticketed and the brand's credit runs fewer than 18 months | 0.5 of them, being 50 percent |
| in every other case | no such treatment applies to the service lines |

The first test counts the agency service lines standing on the booking against the travellers ticketed on it: the lines stand for as many travellers as are ticketed when they are at least that many. The second reads the credit validity term scheduled for the fare brand the booking is held in against 18 months.

## 2. The two readings taken together

Both conditions must hold for either of the first two rows. A booking whose service lines fall short of the travellers ticketed falls outside them however long the brand's credit runs; a booking whose lines are sufficient falls on the first row or the second according to the 18-month test alone.

## 3. Worked figures, on hypothetical inputs

A booking with 2 travellers ticketed, 2 agency service lines coming to 39.90 USD, held in a brand whose credit runs 24 months: the lines stand for as many travellers as are ticketed and 24 is 18 or more, so none of the 39.90 USD is taken off.

The same booking held in a brand whose credit runs 12 months: the lines are sufficient but 12 is fewer than 18, so 50 percent of 39.90 USD, being 19.95 USD, is taken off.

The same booking with only 1 agency service line of 19.95 USD against 2 travellers ticketed: the lines fall short of the travellers, and no such treatment applies to the service lines.
